text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: 16.0 to 16.8 s closer overhead creek. This page differs from option a's sequence-016 by image hash. The white car rides diagonally in the middle of the brown water, nose toward lower left, carried leftward. A scalloped foam mass trails at its upper right end. At 16.0 to 16.4 s two pale smooth curved lines spread from its front corner, one curving up and one down; they fade by 16.6 s. The roof shows a round sensor and small gray seat-back shapes with no figures. The thin squiggly lines and dots remain on the water and do not visibly stream past the car. No separating contact shadow or scale rise is distinguishable. The car passes below the slab and is partly out of frame at left by 16.8 s. Car above the caption box throughout.
